inputs.label: Count, split, and index a bounded FASTA set
inputs.prompt: Count three FASTA files without materializing the records, split one five-record file into chunks of at most two records, build a persistent multi-file index, and verify a random lookup after reopening the index. Report counts and output paths.

inputs.label: Compressed FASTX reader selection and quality encoding
inputs.prompt: Use pyfastx for indexed random access to a gzip FASTA and pysam for a gzip FASTQ. Verify one random-access sequence and compare quality values for a legacy Phred+64 record against an explicit Biopython parser. State which result is scientifically interpretable.

inputs.label: Empty discovery and invalid chunk size
inputs.prompt: Generate the documented CSV summary when the input glob matches no FASTA files, and split a non-empty FASTA with records_per_file set to zero. Do not silently lose records; return actionable failures or valid empty output.

inputs.label: High-cardinality and hostile prefix splitting
inputs.prompt: Split a FASTA containing 2,048 distinct ID prefixes and also a record whose prefix contains ../. Keep resources bounded and guarantee every output stays inside the intended output directory without overwriting a sibling file.

inputs.label: Deterministic traversal and spawn multiprocessing
inputs.prompt: Merge logically identical directories created in different orders and require byte-stable record ordering. Then run the documented per-file multiprocessing recipe under a spawn start method, as used on Windows and macOS, and verify the totals.
